name: v2-two-extruders
review: The three relative E1 commands move tool 0 by 100 steps and tool 1 by 200 steps; XY final positions and directions match the commands. For the two queued perpendicular moves, source-defined junction deviation gives 3.4743 mm/s; independent tick-rounded integration predicts final pulses at 59,949 and 59,653 ticks versus 59,949 and 59,654 recorded. The first move's 62,968 ticks also matches the independently calculated zero-to-zero profile. Both real firmware revisions reproduced this trace. Physical extrusion and board timing remain unverified.
